title: Sleepy lion cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6c0' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff6c0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- soft glow behind cub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='30' fill='#c9781e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#e8a13a' stroke-width='4' stroke-dasharray='9 7'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='33' r='9' fill='#e8a13a'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='33' r='4.5' fill='#f6d98a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='33' r='9' fill='#e8a13a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='33' r='4.5' fill='#f6d98a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='24' fill='#f2b544'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#f9d98c'/>

  <!-- sleepy eyes (closed, downward curves) -->
  <path d='M36 51 Q41 56 46 51' fill='none' stroke='#6b3f12' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 51 Q59 56 64 51' fill='none' stroke='#6b3f12' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 62 Q50 59 54 62 Q50 67 46 62 Z' fill='#b5602a'/>
  <path d='M50 65 L50 70' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 70 Q45 74 42 71' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 70 Q55 74 58 71' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='63' r='4' fill='#f7a98a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='63' r='4' fill='#f7a98a' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- paws tucked under chin -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#f2b544'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='82' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#f2b544'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#f9d98c'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='82' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#f9d98c'/>

  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M74 20 h6 l-6 7 h6' fill='none' stroke='#b8e0ff' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M84 12 h5 l-5 6 h5' fill='none' stroke='#b8e0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
